issue_context.title: Feature: Add support for setting a background image for the app
issue_context.body:
### What feature or improvement do you think would benefit Files?

Hiya, please add option in the Appearance section of the settings to add custom image as background.

### Requirements

- Add combo box with sub options "Image" and "None"
- Include sub setting to select image source
- Include sub setting to change transparency
- Include sub setting to choose image placement

### Files Version

2.5.1.0

### Windows Version

Windows 11 (22H2): 22621

### Comments

_No response_
comments: @onlytanmoy thank you for your feedback, are there any other options you think should go together with this? For example, changing the image transparency so that the mica/acrylic backdrop is visible...

> @yaira2 I am glad you liked this suggestion. I can think of two options for now: a. Controlling the image transparency as you already mentioned b. Have the image source pointed to some folder containing multiple wallpapers for daily auto change of background or a defined rotation frequency like hourly etc.

How to point to image source
We're actively working on this feature and progress can be followed in #15290.
